name: keito
title: Keito
description: Track time in Keito: start, stop, and switch timers, log and edit entries, keep favorites, and see your running timer in the menu bar.
author: eluce2

commands.name: connection
commands.title: Keito Connection
commands.subtitle: Keito
commands.description: Check your Keito API key, Company ID, identity, and project/task access

commands.name: new
commands.title: New Time Entry
commands.subtitle: Keito
commands.description: Start a Keito timer or log a completed time entry

commands.name: listTimeEntries
commands.title: Today's Timesheet

preferences.name: sortBy
preferences.title: Sort By
preferences.description: How should the time entries in your timesheet be sorted?

commands.subtitle: Keito
commands.description: View, edit, restart, and delete today's or previous days' Keito time entries

commands.name: listFavorites
commands.title: Favorites
commands.subtitle: Keito
commands.description: Quick access to favorite time entries

commands.name: toggleTimer
commands.title: Toggle Timer
commands.subtitle: Keito
commands.description: Stop the running Keito timer, or restart today's most recent entry

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Running Timer
commands.subtitle: Keito
commands.description: See your active Keito timer at a glance

preferences.name: showTimerInMenuBar
preferences.label: Show Timer in Menu Bar
preferences.title: Options
preferences.description: Show your running timer in the menu bar

preferences.name: statusFolder
preferences.title: Status Folder
preferences.description: Optional folder where currentTimer.json is written while a timer runs, for automation tools. See README.
preferences.label: Status Folder

commands.name: resetLocalData
commands.title: Reset Local Keito Data
commands.subtitle: Keito
commands.description: Clear cached Keito projects, entries, and verified identity (favorites are kept)

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Keito Integration API Key (optional)
preferences.description: Leave blank to sign in with your Keito account in the browser. Or enter a full-access integration key (kto_…) that a Keito Administrator created for you.

preferences.name: accountID
preferences.title: Keito Company ID (optional)
preferences.description: Only needed with an integration key: Settings → API & Developers → Company ID. Leave blank to sign in with Keito.

preferences.name: showClient
preferences.label: Show Client Name above selected project
preferences.title: Entry Form

preferences.name: showClientInProject
preferences.title: Project Dropdown
preferences.description: Show client name alongside project name in the project dropdown for easier filtering
preferences.label: Show Client Name in Project Dropdown

preferences.name: timeFormat
preferences.title: Time Format
preferences.description: How durations are displayed. Keito does not expose company display settings through the API.

preferences.name: entryMode
preferences.title: Entry Fields
preferences.description: Duration, or start and end times (HH:mm in the Keito workspace timezone). Company Default follows Keito's manual entry format.

preferences.name: titleDisplay
preferences.title: Title Field
preferences.description: What field to display as the title in a list of tasks. The other field will be shown as an accessory.

scripts.publish: npm run test:run && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run check:publish && npx @raycast/api@latest publish
scripts.test:live:write: KEITO_LIVE_WRITE=1 node --env-file="${KEITO_ENV_FILE:-$HOME/.config/keito-raycast/live.env}" node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.live.config.ts src/services/keito/writes.live.ts
